help.discard.count: There {number, plural, one{is # card} other{are # cards}} in {player}'s discard pile.
help.deck.count: There {number, plural, one{is # card} other{are # cards}} in {player}'s deck.
card.solhelios:
You may place this card at the end of a complete row or column to be the 5th card.

This card will then be out of the 4 by 4 square of cards.
card.siegfriedheracles: When placed, choose a card from your discard pile, put it into your deck and shuffle it.
card.ullartemis: When placed, this card has +1 Power for each card in your discard pile, for the battle that follows immediately.
card.frigghera: When placed, this card has +1 Power for each visible icon of your pantheon in the game, its own included, for the battle that follows immediately.
card.thorares: This character ignores the shields from the adjacent opposing cards during the resolution of the battle for this turn.
card.freyjaaphrodite:
When placed, capture an opposing card in the game.

Clarifications: as always, score 1 Glory point per row or column of 3 cards of your pantheon created thanks to the resolution of this effect.
card.helahades:
Place this card on the battlefield, in the 4 by 4 square, then choose a card from your discard pile and place it over Hela/Hades. Its effect triggers as usual.

Clarifications: if it is Váli/Erinyes, after its effect, place Hela/Hades back in the box as well.
card.tyrathena: After the battle, score 1 additional Glory point for each alignment of 3 cards of your pantheon created by its placement.
card.freyrdemeter: After the battle, take one Strength token from the supply.
card.lokiephaistos: After the battle, take one Strength token from the supply for each card captured while resolving this battle.
card.eirasclepios: After the battle, take 2 Strength tokens from the supply.
card.valierinyes:
After the resolution of the battle, put Váli/Erinyes back in the box.

Clarifications: it is possible that the captured cards create an alignment of 3 cards of your pantheon and, therefore, score 1 or several Glory points.
card.balderapollon:
At the end of the game, this card counts for 2 cards of its initial pantheon for the final count.

In other words:
- If {card} has a {otherAllegiance} allegiance at the end of the game, it counts for 1 in the final majority count.
- If {card} has a {cardAllegiance} allegiance at the end of the game, it counts for 2.
card.njordposeidon: Its Power is 2 if {weakness} is in play.
power.help: Permanently increases by 1 the Power of the card that was placed.
shattered.help: Permanently destroys one shield adjacent to the card that was placed.
glory.help:
Gives 1 Glory point.
At the end of the game, the player with the most Glory points wins the game.
majority.help:
At the end of the game, the player with the most visible allegiance icons on the battlefield scores 3 additional Glory points.
The player with the most Glory points wins the game.
allegiance.help:
This token is used to capture a card on the battlefield.
It indicates a {allegiance} allegiance.

header.take-strength.player: Your opponent chooses {count, plural, one{# Strength token} other{# Strength tokens}}

header.glory.player: Your opponent scores {count, plural, one{# Glory point} other{# Glory points}}

header.majority.glory.player: Your opponent wins the allegiance majority (+3 Glory points)

header.draw.player: {player} draws a card from their pantheon

tuto.pantheon: In this game, the Greek and Norse pantheons clash on the battlefield.
tuto.glory: Here are the <bold>Glory points</bold>. You win if you have more than your opponent at the end of the game.
tuto.deck:
Here are your cards. In this game, you play the Greek pantheon.
<italic>Both players have cards with the same abilities. Only the card names change.</italic>
tuto.draw:
At the start of your turn, you begin by drawing a card.
Here, you have drawn <bold>Asclepius</bold>.

You could discard this card to play the next card of your deck, but you choose to keep <bold>Asclepius</bold>.
tuto.asclepios: Place <bold>Asclepius</bold> on the battlefield, in the middle of the table.
tuto.asclepios.effect:
<bold>Asclepius</bold> has an ability: you take <bold>2 Strength tokens</bold>.

Take a <power /> token, then a <shattered /> token.
They'll come in handy later.
tuto.adjacent: Your opponent draws, and must play their card adjacent to a card already on the battlefield.
tuto.siegfried.effect:
After placing their card, the battle is resolved.
<bold>Sigurd</bold>'s Power is 3. <bold>Asclepius</bold>'s is 2.
Your opponent captures your card and places an <bold>Allegiance token</bold> on it.
tuto.hera: Now it's your turn. You have drawn <bold>Hera</bold>.
tuto.hera.discard:
On the turn she is played, <bold>Hera</bold> gains 1 Power per card of your allegiance in play.
Her ability is useless for now. Fortunately, you can <bold>discard the drawn card</bold> to draw another.
<bold>Discard Hera</bold>.
tuto.discard:
When you discard your first card, <bold>you are forced to play the next card</bold>.
You must therefore place <bold>Dionysus</bold> on the battlefield.
tuto.shields: Some cards have <bold>shields</bold>, represented by a red border. For example, <bold>Sigurd</bold> has a shield on the right, on the left and on top.
tuto.shields.block: Attacks from shielded sides are ignored. If you place <bold>Dionysus</bold> next to <bold>Sigurd</bold>, you won't capture him!
tuto.shattered: However, you have a Strength token that allows you to <bold>shatter the shield</bold>.
tuto.dionysos:
Now use a Strength token to destroy <bold>Sigurd</bold>'s shield adjacent to <bold>Dionysus</bold>.

Then click on the “trigger the battle” button at the top of the screen.
tuto.opponent.discard: It's your opponent's turn, and they choose to discard the first card they drew.
tuto.nerthus: Your opponent has drawn <bold>Nerthus</bold>, and played her here, capturing <bold>Dionysus</bold>.
tuto.fragility: <bold>Nerthus</bold> has a <bold>fragility</bold> on these 3 sides. If you place a card adjacent to one of these edges, <bold>you will capture it regardless of the Power of the two cards</bold>.
tuto.aphrodite: It's up to you. You have drawn <bold>Aphrodite</bold>.
tuto.aphrodite.fragility: Put <bold>Aphrodite</bold> here. <bold>Aphrodite</bold> is weaker than <bold>Nerthus</bold>, but as <bold>Nerthus</bold> has a fragility she will be captured anyway!
tuto.aphrodite.power:
<bold>Aphrodite</bold> has a placement ability: you can capture the opposing card of your choice!
Use her ability to capture <bold>Asclepius</bold>.
tuto.battle: Click on the <battle>trigger the battle</battle> button.
tuto.alignement:
You've created an alignment of exactly 3 cards of your allegiance!
Each time a player creates such an alignment, <bold>they score 1 Glory point</bold>.
<italic>You score no point if you create an alignment of 4 cards of your allegiance.</italic>
tuto.battlefield: The game continues in this way until the battlefield, a square of 4 by 4 cards, is complete.
tuto.end:
At the end of the game, the player with <bold>the most visible allegiance icons</bold> scores 3 additional Glory points.
Finally, <bold>the player with the most Glory points wins.</bold>
tuto.summary:
There are 3 types of ability on the cards:
<play/> Placement ability
<afterbattle/> Post-battle effect
<end/> End-game effect
At any time, you can <bold>click on a card to discover its ability</bold>.
tuto.go:
Now it's your turn.
Good luck, and may the gods be with you!
